title: New Fruits and Vegetables for Gardeners to Try
titleZh: 园艺师可以尝试的新果蔬品种
credits: The Associated Press gardening expert Jessica Damiano wrote this report. Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English. ____________________________________________________

sentences.en: If you are a gardener, you probably have some favorite plants that you grow year after year.
sentences.zh: 如果你是个园艺爱好者，你大概会有一些年年都种的 favorite 植物。

sentences.en: But you might also like to try new plants sometimes.
sentences.zh: 不过，有时你也可能想尝试一些新的植物。

sentences.en: Gardening expert Jessica Damiano recently reported for the Associated Press about one way to find new plants that might appeal to growers.
sentences.zh: 园艺专家杰西卡·达米亚诺最近为美联社报道了一种寻找可能受种植者欢迎的新植物的方法。

sentences.en: Each year, the independent, nonprofit organization All-America Selections (AAS) enlists more than 80 horticultural professionals from around the United States and Canada to serve as plant-trial judges.
sentences.zh: 每年，这个独立的非营利组织全美精选（AAS）都会招募来自美国和加拿大的80多位园艺专业人士担任植物试验评审。

sentences.en: Their job is to grow the new plants side-by-side with currently available varieties.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作就是把新植物与目前市面上已有的品种并排种植进行对比。

sentences.en: The group then compares plant performance, time to reach full growth, flower or fruit size, disease resistance and other qualities important to home gardeners.
sentences.zh: 然后，该组会对植物的表现、达到完全生长的时间、花朵或果实的大小、抗病性以及对家庭园艺者来说重要的其他品质进行比较。

sentences.en: When the results are gathered, the best plants are named AAS winners for the following year in time for their launch on the market.
sentences.zh: 当结果汇总后，最好的植物会被评为次年的全美精选获奖品种，以便及时推向市场。

sentences.en: For 2025, 20 plants have been named national or local winners.
sentences.zh: 2025年，已有20种植物被评为全国或地区获奖品种。

sentences.en: Seven of them are edible plants, meaning they can be eaten.
sentences.zh: 其中7种是可食用植物，也就是说它们可以被食用。

sentences.en: Here are the new kinds of edible plants that some gardeners might be interested in.
sentences.zh: 以下是些园艺者可能感兴趣的新式可食用植物。

sentences.en: Two of the winners received the honor under the regional, or local, identification.
sentences.zh: 其中两种获奖是在地区性或地方性类别中获得的荣誉。

sentences.en: The Basil Piedmont of the Great Lakes and Heartland regions was noted for its strong resistance to disease, especially that of the fungus called downy mildew.
sentences.zh: 大湖地区和中部地带的“罗勒皮埃德蒙特”因其对疾病尤其是被称为霜霉病的真菌病害有较强抵抗力而受到关注。

sentences.en: The experts also favored its strong smell, classic flavor and “refined habit.”
sentences.zh: 专家们还青睐它浓郁的气味、经典的风味和“精致的株型”。

sentences.en: Harvested plants keep for a long period, the judges said.
sentences.zh: 评审们说，收获的果实能长时间保存。

sentences.en: The dense, bushy plant also was honored for strong growth and health, even in difficult growing conditions.
sentences.zh: 这种茂密、丛生的植物还因在困难生长条件下依然生长旺盛、健康而受到赞誉。

sentences.en: Garden Genetics and Seeds by Design produced the new plant.
sentences.zh: 这种新植物由花园遗传公司和设计种子公司培育而成。

sentences.en: Tomato Tonatico F1 of the Mountain/Southwest and Northeast regions also was a winner.
sentences.zh: 山地/西南地区和东北地区的“番茄托纳蒂科F1”也是获奖品种。

sentences.en: Judges praised the taste, texture, yield, disease resistance and reduced fruit cracking and splitting of this cherry tomato.
sentences.zh: 评审们称赞这种圣女果的味道、口感、产量、抗病性以及减少的果实开裂和裂果现象。

sentences.en: Tonatico also was noted for its strongly attached, uniform fruit clusters that were easy to remove at harvest time.
sentences.zh: 托纳蒂科还因其果实紧密附着、大小均匀、在收获时易于采摘而受到关注。

sentences.en: The fruit was created, or bred, by Bejo USA.
sentences.zh: 这种果实由贝乔美国公司培育而成。

sentences.en: The Cauliflower Murasaki Fioretto 70 F1 is among the five winners in the national class.
sentences.zh: 花椰菜Murasaki Fioretto 70 F1是全国类别的五个获奖品种之一。

sentences.en: Murasaki translates to “purple” in Japanese.
sentences.zh: "Murasaki"在日语中意为"紫色"。

sentences.en: This cauliflower has bright purple flowers, as well as long, soft stems.
sentences.zh: 这种花椰菜拥有鲜艳的紫色花朵，以及修长柔软的茎。

sentences.en: The experts said the plant matures, or reaches full growth, early and is easy to harvest.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，这种植物成熟早，即生长完全，且易于收获。

sentences.en: It does not have a strong flavor and would make a beautiful purple food to serve raw, or uncooked.
sentences.zh: 它没有浓郁的风味，可作为漂亮的紫色食材生食或未经烹煮食用。

sentences.en: It will turn to a fuchsia color in vinegar and golden brown when lightly cooked.
sentences.zh: 它在醋中会变成紫红色，轻微烹煮后则呈金棕色。

sentences.en: Tokita Seed America bred the plant.
sentences.zh: 该植物由Tokita Seed America培育而成。

sentences.en: Winner Kohlrabi Konstance F1 is also a purple plant.
sentences.zh: 获奖品种苤蓝Konstance F1也是一种紫色植物。

sentences.en: Judges said it grew well in both spring and fall.
sentences.zh: 评委表示，它在春季和秋季都生长良好。

sentences.en: It produced crack-resistant, long-lasting bulbs with smooth, bright skin.
sentences.zh: 它结出的球茎抗裂、耐储存，表皮光滑、色泽鲜亮。

sentences.en: It also offers a longer harvest period than other varieties and tasty leaves.
sentences.zh: 它比其他品种拥有更长的收获期，且叶片美味。

sentences.en: Bejo Seeds is the breeder.
sentences.zh: Bejo Seeds是培育者。

sentences.en: The winning Pepper Pick-N-Pop Yellow F1 was noted for “outstanding” resistance to bacterial leaf spot disease.
sentences.zh: 获奖的Pepper Pick-N-Pop Yellow F1以对细菌性叶斑病的“杰出”抗性著称。

sentences.en: Judges also found that the plant produced sweet, yellow, small peppers throughout the growing season.
sentences.zh: 评委还发现，该植物在整个生长季都结出甜口、黄色、小辣椒。

sentences.en: The company Seminis Home Garden was the breeder.
sentences.zh: Seminis Home Garden公司是该品种的培育者。

sentences.en: Squash Green Lightning F1 was praised for its small seed cavity.
sentences.zh: Squash Green Lightning F1因其较小的种子腔而受到赞誉。

sentences.en: This results in more edible flesh from each fruit.
sentences.zh: 这使得每个果实能提供更多可食用的果肉。

sentences.en: Green Lightning lived up to its name in the trials, judges said.
sentences.zh: 据评委介绍，Green Lightning在试验中名副其实。

sentences.en: They noted how quickly it reached maturity.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到它成熟的速度之快。

sentences.en: One judge said, “This entry not only looked better but also tasted better than the comparison,” adding it looked good enough to use as a decoration.
sentences.zh: 一位评委说：“这一品种不仅外观更好，味道也优于对照品种，”并补充说它的外观好到足以用作装饰。

sentences.en: The judge said the squash’s flavor when cooked “stood up to added seasonings.”
sentences.zh: 法官表示，这种南瓜烹饪后的风味"能够与添加的调味料相媲美"。

sentences.en: Green Lightning was bred by Joseph Stern and marketed by PanAmerican Seed.
sentences.zh: "绿光"南瓜由约瑟夫·斯特恩培育，由泛美种子公司推向市场。

sentences.en: Another winner, Squash Thriller F1, was noted for its unusual color-changing quality.
sentences.zh: 另一位获奖品种"南瓜惊悚者F1"以其不寻常的颜色变化特性而闻名。

sentences.en: Judges also said it was easy to grow.
sentences.zh: 评委们还说它易于种植。

sentences.en: The plants produce 1-to-2-pound fruits with bright orange-, green- and white-ridged lines that change color as they mature.
sentences.zh: 这些植物结出1至2磅重的果实，带有鲜艳的橙色、绿色和白色条纹，成熟时颜色会发生变化。

sentences.en: Sakata America bred the Squash Thriller.
sentences.zh: "南瓜惊悚者"由三井美国培育。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。
